newsitem.title: NEW ZEALAND: FCL Energy March qtr production rises.
newsitem.headline: FCL Energy March qtr production rises.

text.p: Fletcher Challenge Energy said on Monday that total oil and gas production in the March 1997 quarter was up 37 percent on the previous corresponding period.

FCL Energy said total production for the quarter was 12.857 mmboe. Production of liquids increased by 48 percent to 5.7 million barrels reflecting increased condensate production from the Maui Field and the inclusion of three months' oil production from the Maui F and D sands.
"Gas production at 40.8 bcf rose by 24 percent as demand from New Zealand thermal power stations was at unseasonally high levels," FCL Energy said.
In Canada, successful infill drilling programmes increased oil production by 4.0 percent to 17,833 barrels of oil per day.
Onshore New Zealand, three exploration wells had been drilled, all of which encountered hydrocarbons.
FCL Energy confirmed it had acquired a 36.75 percent interest in the undeveloped offshore New Zealand Kupe gas and condensate field.
